Subject: URGENT: Hotel Alder hold declined at check-in (Redwood attendees)

Hi Hannah and Ben,

Quick heads up — Hotel Alder flagged a declined corporate hold at front desk for two of your attendees checking in this morning for the Redwood executive workshop. They allowed the guests to check in but declined to capture the standard $150/night incidental hold. They said they need authorization to charge a corporate card or a prepaid guarantee to release the folio.

I've attached the provisional folio (folio-hotel-alder.pdf). Can Redwood either: (1) provide a replacement card number for the hold, (2) confirm we should take a guest personal card and Redwood will reimburse, or (3) instruct us to send an invoice to Redwood for immediate settlement? Hotel is requesting direction today to avoid escalation.

Also, Hotel Alder notes they did not receive itemized receipts for two earlier incidental charges flagged under the group block — please advise.

Thanks — we can hop on a quick call if easier.

Best,
Julia Kaplan
Acme Events (on-site coordinator)

Immediate plan:
- Marissa / Finance (cc'd) — can you confirm whether Procurement can issue a replacement virtual card today that covers the incidental hold and the two flagged incidentals? If not, we'll request an ACH.
- Ben — can you confirm which two attendees were impacted (names and room numbers) so we can match to folio lines?

We should be able to resolve today.

Cheers,

Our procurement team will push the virtual card token via the secure DocuSign gateway this afternoon (you should receive a notification from payments@procurepay.com). - Generate itemized receipts for the two incidental charges that were missing from the folio and send them to billing@redwood.com and julia.kaplan@acmecorp.com.
- Do not post any charges to the attendees' personal cards until we confirm the virtual card authorization.

If there are any issues with the DocuSign token or if the hotel needs an immediate ACH, reply to this thread and cc procurement@redwood.com; Marissa will coordinate the payment. We expect to close this internally within 24 hours.
